name: humour
prompt: A funny, warm old Indian farmer talks to the camera. First he pats his stomach twice with his hand and chuckles, as if he is hungry; then he lifts that hand calmly in a patient 'wait, wait' gesture and gives the camera a knowing look and a soft laugh. His other hand keeps holding his wooden walking stick. Flat 2D cartoon style, clean outlines, static camera, smooth natural human movement.

name: hoe
prompt: The old farmer loosens the red soil with his spade in slow, steady strokes: he pushes the blade into the soil, lifts a little soil and turns it over so it breaks into fine loose crumbs, then does it again a little further along. His body leans naturally with each stroke; his face stays calm and content. Flat 2D cartoon style, clean outlines, static camera, smooth natural human movement.
